title: AIDisclosurePackage
description: docs/canonical/TZ-00-domain-event-canon.md, section 19c.6 (added by canon 0.5.0, ADR-023/ADR-025). A contract/value object, not a canonical system-of-record entity - ai-processing-service constructs this and passes it as raw_content to transparency-service.publish_ledger_entry (PublicLedgerEntry.subject_type = ai_processing_record). Never persisted by either service; its only durable trace is the resulting PublicLedgerEntry row plus the opaque disclosure_package_reference/disclosure_receipt_reference fields recorded on the source AIProcessingRecord. Every field here is already public-safe by construction - no raw input, private output, hidden prompt, reviewer identity, RoleAssignment UUID, identity/credential/vote data, or hidden reasoning has a field on this object at all.
